key_idea: In 3 years each of the two children gets 3 years older.
steps: Now Mia and Noah are 11 years old together.
In 3 years Mia is 3 years older, and Noah is 3 years older too.

choice_feedback.A: 14 adds the 3 years only once. Both children get older.
choice_feedback.B: Each child gets 3 years older, so add 3 + 3 = 6 years.
choice_feedback.C: Each child gets 3 years older, so add 3 + 3 = 6 years.
choice_feedback.E: Each child gets 3 years older, so add 3 + 3 = 6 years, not 7.
